lines.speaker: harry
lines.text: I came for ten quiet minutes, not a war reunion.

lines.speaker: draconia
lines.text: Tell your scar to stop picking my partners.

lines.speaker: harry
lines.text: That was not my spell.

lines.speaker: draconia
lines.text: Then congratulations, Potter. The floor hates both of us.

lines.speaker: draconia
lines.text: It is not locking us out. It is inviting us back in.

lines.speaker: harry
lines.text: Every crack lands on a beat. This is choreography, not damage.

lines.speaker: draconia
lines.text: Then let us give it a count it did not expect.

lines.speaker: draconia
lines.text: Do not make this noble, Potter. It was one dance.

lines.speaker: harry
lines.text: Then give me one honest thing before you go.

lines.speaker: draconia
lines.text: I wanted the card to choose us.

lines.speaker: harry
lines.text: Draconia, the forest is answering.

lines.speaker: draconia
lines.text: One dance, one haunting, zero sensible decisions. A perfect evening.

lines.speaker: harry
lines.text: I asked for honesty, not a review of my decisions.

lines.speaker: draconia
lines.text: That is either an invitation or a threat. Wonderful. My favorite kind.
